format.definition_identity: Existing ModelDefinition fingerprint includes name and voxel bytes; fixed32byte SHA256 digest on wire. Definitions are opaque8/16/32-resolution component assets.

format.scope: Private uncompressed diagnostic envelope, not a game importer or production save format

limitations: Diagnostic byte/count caps do not establish peak heap or application performance. Decode checks accumulated definition bytes after each existing bounded ModelDefinition.read, so one additional record of at most200000body bytes plus4length bytes can parse before aggregate rejection. Cancellation inside existing model parsing/meshing has per-definition granularity. Encoding holds bounded definition/region byte arrays and a final envelope copy.
